{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_orders = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Calculate conversion fraction
conversion_fraction = loyal_orders['converted'].mean()

print(f"Number of loyal customer orders: {len(loyal_orders)}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customer orders: {loyal_orders['converted'].sum()}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")"}
